session_mapping_rules_investigated.rule_before_close: news published on trading day t at/before 16:00 ET maps to prediction timestamp t (available by close t)
session_mapping_rules_investigated.rule_after_close: news published on trading day t after 16:00 ET maps to prediction timestamp t+1 (first available by close t+1)
session_mapping_rules_investigated.rule_weekend: Saturday/Sunday news maps to the next Monday (or next trading day) prediction timestamp as pre-open information
session_mapping_rules_investigated.rule_exchange_holiday: holiday news maps to the next trading session prediction timestamp
session_mapping_rules_investigated.assessment: rules are well-defined ONLY given second-precision publication timestamps with known timezone plus a holiday calendar; yfinance meets the timestamp bar but has no history, GDELT fails the timestamp bar (seendate != pubtime), key-gated sources unverifiable here

verdict.statement: No free, reproducible source available in this environment covers the full 2016-01-01..2026-08-31 period with publication timestamps and ticker-level association. Forcing Task 3C on yfinance-recent or GDELT-keyword data would violate leakage-free and timestamp requirements.
verdict.no_synthetic_substitution: no synthetic, randomly generated, current-news-as-history, or unrelated-sentiment data was created or substituted; samples are small live reads recorded above
verdict.recommended_next_step: STOP sentiment modelling until either (a) a licensed entity-resolved timestamped feed (e.g. Bloomberg/RavenPack/Refinitiv, or Alpha Vantage premium with key + timestamp/entity validation) is procured, or (b) project scope is formally reduced (e.g. forward-only collection from today, or a shorter window covered by an accessible archive). Any choice requires re-audit before Task 3C modelling.
